% \includegraphics pictures in boxes that mirror or turn them over:
% \reflectbox at the natural size and with a width, \scalebox with
% negative factors (also halving, and turning over), two \reflectbox, a
% \reflectbox in a box that scales, two pictures in one \reflectbox, a
% \reflectbox inside a TikZ node, a \reflectbox around a rotation and
% inside one, a picture with a height that does not keep its aspect turned
% over, a picture halved and turned over at full width, a picture without
% its .xbb file turned over at a width and with a height, mirrored pictures
% around rotations in a figure, for the viewer, and a mirrored picture in a
% link, a footnote, a table, a minipage, a theorem, italic text, and a
% figure. A picture turned over hangs below the baseline in the PDF, as
% graphics.sty swaps its height and depth. Every rotation is by 90 degrees:
% headless Chrome under load antialiased a picture at 30 degrees differently
% from one capture to the next, which failed the visual check.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
Bare: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={bare}]{test-picture.png}} after.

Width: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={width}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Half: \scalebox{-0.5}[0.5]{\includegraphics[alt={half}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Half bare: \scalebox{-0.5}[0.5]{\includegraphics[alt={half bare}]{test-picture.png}} after.

Half over: \scalebox{-0.5}{\includegraphics[alt={half over}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Two: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={left}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png} \includegraphics[alt={right}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Drawn: \tikz\node{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}}; after.

Turned over: \scalebox{1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={over}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Turned over bare: \scalebox{1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={over bare}]{test-picture.png}} after.

Turned round: \scalebox{-1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={round}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Rotated: \reflectbox{\rotatebox{90}{\includegraphics[alt={rotated}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Angle: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={angle}, angle=90, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Rotated inside: \rotatebox{90}{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={rotated inside}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Squashed: \scalebox{1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={squashed}, width=100pt, height=20pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

No box: \scalebox{1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={over no box}, width=100pt]{test-bare.png}} after.

No box squashed: \scalebox{1}[-1]{\includegraphics[alt={squashed no box}, width=100pt, height=20pt]{test-bare.png}} after.

Flattened: \scalebox{1}[-0.5]{\includegraphics[alt={flattened}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}} after.

Twice: \reflectbox{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={twice}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Nested: \scalebox{0.5}{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={nested}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Link: \href{https://example.com}{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={link}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}} after.

Footnote.\footnote{In a note:
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={footnote}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}.}

\begin{tabular}{|l|}
\hline
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={cell}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}} \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

\begin{minipage}{0.5\textwidth}
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={minipage}, width=\textwidth]{test-picture.png}}
\end{minipage}

\begin{theorem}
A picture: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={theorem}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}.
\end{theorem}

\textit{In italic: \reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={italic}, width=50pt]{test-picture.png}}.}

\centering
\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={figure}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}
\caption{A mirrored picture.}

\reflectbox{\rotatebox{90}{\reflectbox{\includegraphics[alt={viewed twice}, width=100pt]{test-picture.png}}}}
\caption{Mirrored pictures around rotations.}
